method: Gaussian-filtered IID normal grid, sigma=lc/(sqrt(2)*dx), 20-cell padding; trilinear samples at original bond midpoints; subtract bulk mean and divide by bulk maximum absolute value
lc_meaning: Nominal pre-normalization covariance exp(-r^2/(2 lc^2)); finite specimen and centering affect empirical covariance
alpha_meaning: Maximum bounded relative onset perturbation, not standard deviation
status: EXPLORATORY_UNCALIBRATED; varying onset also changes damage dissipation; not fixed Gc
